resources.string: (encrypted; the first attachment needs a paid key exchange)

Photos, files and voice notes are locked with a key you share with this contact. That key comes from a key exchange, and this chat hasn\'t had one yet. Switch this chat to Shielded and send a message to make one; it costs ZEC, and ZChat shows the price first. Your contact needs ZChat 2.13 or newer.

Photos, files and voice notes are locked with a key you share with this contact, and it comes from your key exchange, which hasn\'t happened yet. Send a text message first: it starts the key exchange. ZChat shows the total for the key exchange and your message, and nothing is paid until you confirm.

Photos, files and voice notes are locked with a key you share with this contact. It comes from your key exchange with them, which isn\'t finished yet: their answer hasn\'t arrived. You can send these once it does.

Photos, files and voice notes are locked with a key you share with this contact. It comes from your key exchange with them, and yours hasn\'t been sent yet, so nothing is on its way. You can send these once it is sent and your contact answers.

Sending your key exchange can take an on-chain handshake transaction that costs at least 0.00017 ZEC. If you have allowed handshake transactions, it is paid without another question; otherwise nothing is paid until you agree.

Photos, files and voice notes are locked with a key you share with this contact. Your contact sent a key exchange, and it is waiting for you to accept it in this chat. You can send these once you have accepted it.
Not sent — photos, files and voice notes need a key exchange with this contact first. Nothing was uploaded or paid.
Not sent — ZChat is still reading your chat history, and photos, files and voice notes can\'t be sent to this contact while it reads. Nothing was uploaded or paid.
This can\'t be sent again from here. Pick the photo or file again, or record the voice note again, to send it.
